title: Exact extension adjoint for localized restriction
statement: For a sheaf of rings R on a Grothendieck site and an object U, assuming localized restriction preserves zero morphisms, there exists a functor G from localized module sheaves to module sheaves preserving finite limits and finite colimits and left adjoint to restriction.

proof.text: Use SheafOfModules.extensionByZeroPresheaf for the actual direct-sum presheaf, at module universe max u v. Its restriction formula on a generator follows from DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of. Construct mutually inverse maps between presheaf morphisms out of this presheaf and module-sheaf morphisms into localized restriction: sum the components in one direction and compose with DirectSum.lof in the other. Prove naturality and the inverse laws on generators. Compose this Hom equivalence with PresheafOfModules.sheafificationHomEquiv and its naturality to construct the adjunction for the sheafified functor G.

Evaluation of module sheaves preserves finite limits, so it takes a monomorphism to a monomorphism of section modules, hence an injective linear map by ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective. Apply DirectSum.lmap_injective on every object and PresheafOfModules.mono_of_injective to show the direct-sum presheaf functor preserves monomorphisms. Exact module sheafification (Mathlib PresheafOfModules.sheafification, whose preservation of finite limits is reflected through the underlying abelian sheaf functor) preserves monomorphisms, so the composite G does too.

Restriction is additive by its sectionwise formula. Adjunction.left_adjoint_additive makes G additive, while Adjunction.leftAdjoint_preservesColimits gives finite-colimit preservation. Functor.preservesHomology_of_preservesMonos_and_cokernels then gives preservation of homology from the proved preservation of monomorphisms and cokernels. Functor.preservesFiniteLimits_of_preservesHomology gives preservation of finite limits. Package G, these two preservation witnesses, and the constructed adjunction.

proof_origin.place: Lemmas 03DI and 03DJ; explicit Lean Hom equivalence adapted from proved private helpers in Sheaf.CategoryTheory.LocalizedModuleAdjunctionExact

lean.statement:
theorem localized_restriction_extension_exists
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    (R : Sheaf J RingCat.{max u v}) (U : C)
    (hzero : (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{max u v} R U).PreservesZeroMorphisms) :
    ∃ (G : SheafOfModules.{max u v} (R.over U) ⥤ SheafOfModules.{max u v} R),
      PreservesFiniteLimits G ∧ PreservesFiniteColimits G ∧
      Nonempty (G ⊣ SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{max u v} R U)
